Name: Nyan Cat - Cat Retexture for Alternative Textures
Author: AngelOfStars
Description:
The only mod I saw for this is from 2016 surprisingly, so I decided to go ahead and make a new one! 

Kudos to the mod that did this first: [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/109]Nyan Pet Cat[/url] - it's an XNB replacement mod, so it might be difficult to use, but I still wanted to let people know it exists!

All assets used in this mod were made by me with reference to the way CA makes cats :)

[b]If you like the stuff I make, consider sending me a [/b][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/lilydoesthingssometimes]ko-fi[/url]﻿ - never required of course, I do this stuff for fun, but it does make it easier to focus on making things.[/b]

Manifest.Description: Texture your cat as the one and only Nyan Cat!
